sections.heading: Description
lines: Warped Forest is a custom field effect that does not appear in Pokémon Rejuvenation. It is based on the Nether biome of the same name and is found in the Warped Forest biome.
The field combines parts of Forest Field, Dimensional Field, Wasteland and Volcanic Field. Weather cannot last here and nothing can be frozen.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Grass-type, Dark-type and special Bug-type moves increase in base power by 1.5x.
Ghost-type moves increase in base power by 1.2x.
Fire-type moves increase in base power by 1.3x.
Water-type moves decrease in base power to 0.8x.
Ice-type and Fairy-type moves decrease in base power to 0.5x.
Damaging Grass-type moves also count as Dark-type when type effectiveness is calculated. The extra type changes damage only; it never adds same-type attack bonus.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Effect Spore's activation rate is doubled to 60%.
Grass Pelt, Leaf Guard, Overgrow and Swarm are active as in Forest Field.
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Dark.
Poison Heal and Toxic Boost work for grounded Pokémon.
Rattled raises Speed by 1 stage when the bearer enters.
Sap Sipper restores 1/16 of its max HP at the end of each turn.
Unnerve lowers the opposing Pokémon's Speed by 1 stage when the bearer enters.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Power Whip, Vine Whip → 1.5x boost on top of the Grass-type bonus (2.25x in total).
Dark Pulse, Night Daze → 1.2x boost on top of the Dark-type bonus (1.8x in total). These moves never miss.
Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Shadow Force, Spacial Rend → 1.5x boost.
Other moves:
Slash, Air Slash, Fury Cutter, Air Cutter, Psycho Cut, Breaking Swipe and Cut gain the Grass type, as in Forest Field.
Leech Seed drains 1/4 of the target's max HP each turn instead of 1/8.
Gravity, Magic Room, Trick Room and Wonder Room last a random 3 to 8 turns.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Dark.
Nature Power becomes Wood Hammer.
Secret Power may cause the target to flinch.
Shelter halves damage from Dark-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Dark.

sections.heading: Weather and Status
lines: Weather cannot be started here, and weather already in effect disappears when the field begins.
Pokémon cannot be frozen.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Magical Seed raises Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage each, lowers Speed by 1 stage and applies Ingrain to the user.
